svg.aria-label: Every Massachusetts town shaded by spent per pupil by its schools, darkest where it is highest. Lunenburg is outlined in red at $18,027, against a middle town of $22,308. Towns with no figure published are left blank.
svg.text: Spent per pupil by its schools, town by town
Only towns running their own K–12 district, SY2025. Lunenburg outlined in red: $18,027. The middle town: $22,308.
Shaded by RANK, not by amount: a few towns hold most of the total on nearly every measure here.
The web version of this report switches this map between 14 measures and names every town under the cursor.
